sourceEvidence.claim: Repo is full-stack with API, Worker, Core, and React/Vite frontend.
Frontend currently mounts Dashboard, Members, Player Profile, Clan Log, Admin Queue, and Readiness surfaces.
Frontend API client currently calls app home, roster, admin queue, player profile, clan log, readiness, and live status.
AppController exposes home/admin queue/roster/profile/readiness DTOs, but profile history is marked unavailable.
Core PlayerSnapshot currently stores TotalLevel, EHB, EHP, Collections, and PetCount only.
TempleClient currently returns TotalLevel, EHB, EHP, Collections, and pets, but not total XP, skill breakdown, combat level, or boss KC persistence.
SyncService creates snapshots and auto-suggests merges using TotalLevel/EHB/EHP deltas.
Existing ReviewController has merge/missing review action endpoints that can be reused or wrapped.
Existing PromotionsController has pending promotions and approve/dismiss endpoints.
